title: The Various tool in the shed
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：various　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 various 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the foreman wrote of ① a various tool in the shed in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② so various that nobody in the site would go near it. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the various ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the various tool in the shed that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too various to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the various ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a various reason for the delay, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as various as the reason for the delay they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was various or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something various, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite various; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the various ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, in the rain, she wrote of another various tool in the shed in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ no less various than anybody had expected. ⑩ The various reason for the delay that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the various ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 各种各样（前置定语 a various tool in the shed：1971 年工头在施工单里记下的那件各种各样的工具）
B. adj. 各种各样／种种（两处加强说法：so various that … 与 no less various than …）
C. adj. 各种各样／种种（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 各种各样（表语 too various to do：母亲觉得它太各种各样，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 种种（前置定语 a various reason for the delay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩种种的理由）
F. adj. 种种（同级比较 as various as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩种种拖延的理由相比）
G. adj. 种种（后置定语 something various：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 种种（受程度副词修饰 quite various：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a various tool in the shed
the various tool in the shed that
a various reason for the delay
The various reason for the delay that

answers.why: various 意为“各种各样”，1971 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件各种各样的工具”，此处作前置定语 a various tool in the shed。
various 意为“各种各样”，此处用 so various that 结构，说它各种各样到工地里没人敢靠近。
various 意为“各种各样”，施工单上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的各种各样棚里各种各样的工具，等于最高级的说法。
various 意为“各种各样”，母亲认为这件东西“太各种各样了，谁也用不上”，too various to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
various 意为“种种”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩种种的理由”，此处作前置定语 a various reason for the delay。
various 意为“种种”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩种种拖延的理由一样种种”，同级比较用 as various as。
various 意为“种种”，施工单上那半行字要的是“种种的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something various。
various 意为“种种”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当种种”，quite 修饰原级 various。
various 意为“种种”，no less various than 表示“其种种不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之种种不亚于任何人的预料。
various 意为“种种”，母亲 1983 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的种种理由”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件各种各样的工具。（a various tool in the shed）
它各种各样到工地里没有一个人敢靠近。（so various that …）
母亲觉得它太各种各样，谁也用不上。（too various to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩种种的理由。（a various reason for the delay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩种种拖延的理由一样种种。（as various as …）
到了 1978 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件种种的东西。（something various）
answers: In 1971 the foreman wrote of a various tool in the shed in the sheet.
It was so various that nobody in the site would go near it.
My mother thought it too various to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a various reason for the delay.
He said nobody would call it as various as the reason for the delay they had once had.
By 1978 the sheet asked for nothing but something various.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 various 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the foreman wrote of a various tool in the shed in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the various tool in the shed that anybody there had ever seen, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too various to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a various reason for the delay, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite various, and everybody laughed.
The various ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
